h: חַג הַפֶּסַח, מַאֲמָר י״ד Pesach — Maamar Yud Daled

p: בַּגְּמָרָא
In the Gemara
(בְּרָכוֹת י"ז.):
(Berachos 17a):
גָּלוּי וְיָדוּעַ לְפָנֶיךָ שֶׁרְצוֹנֵנוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ, וּמִי מְעַכֵּב? שְׂאוֹר שֶׁבָּעִיסָּה וְשִׁיעְבּוּד מַלְכִיּוֹת.
"It is revealed and known before You that our will is to do Your will, and what prevents us? The leaven in the dough and subjugation to the kingdoms."
בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
In the holy Zohar
(חֵלֶק ג' רל"ב:, רל"ז:):
עֵרֶב רַב — עֲלֵיהוֹן אִיתְּמַר: מִי מְעַכֵּב? שְׂאוֹר שֶׁבָּעִיסָּה.
"The Mixed Multitude—concerning them it is said: 'What prevents us? The leaven in the dough.'"
וְרַשִׁ"י פֵּירֵשׁ: שְׂאוֹר שֶׁבָּעִיסָּה — יֵצֶר הָרָע הַמַּחְמִיצֵנוּ.
And Rashi explained: "The leaven in the dough"—the evil inclination that sours us.
אַךְ בְּתִיקּוּנֵי זֹהַר
However, in Tikkunei Zohar
(תִּיקּוּן כ"א):
(Tikkun 21):
שְׂאוֹר וְחָמֵץ דְּאִינּוּן סָמֶ"ךְ מֵ"ם וְנָחָשׁ, עֵרֶב רַב, וְאוֹמָאָה דְּיִתְמַחוּן בְּי"ד
"Leaven and chametz, which are Satan and the Serpent, the Mixed Multitude, and there is an oath that they be blotted out on the fourteenth"
וְהַיְינוּ דְּהַכֹּל אֶחָד: שְׂאוֹר וְסָמֶ"ךְ מֵ"ם וְעֵרֶב רַב.
meaning that they are all one: leaven, Satan, and the Mixed Multitude.
וּבְתִיקּוּנֵי זֹהַר שָׁם
And in Tikkunei Zohar there
וְרַשִּׁיעַיָּא דְּאִינּוּן עֵרֶב רַב מִזַּרְעָא דַּעֲמָלֵק וְכוּלֵּי.
"And the wicked ones who are the Mixed Multitude are from the seed of Amalek, etc."
וְהַיְינוּ עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁמּוּבָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
And this is based on what is brought in the holy Zohar
(חֵלֶק ג' ק"ס.):
הָא עֲמָלֵק יִצְרָא בִּישָׁא, קַטֵּיגוֹרָא דְּבַר נָשׁ וְכוּלֵּי
"Behold, Amalek is the evil inclination, the prosecutor of man, etc."
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁעַל יְדֵי שֶׁיֵּשׁ מְצִיאוּת מֵרַע בְּאוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם, נִכְנָס לְלֵב יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׂאוֹר שֶׁבָּעִיסָּה הַמַּחְמִיצֵנוּ, וְהוּא הַסָּמֶ"ךְ מֵ"ם, הוּא הַנָּחָשׁ.
meaning that because there exists an entity of evil among the nations of the world, the leaven in the dough enters the heart of Israel and sours us—and that is Satan, that is the Serpent.
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמְרוּ
And this is what they said
(סוּכָּה נ"ב.):
(Sukkah 52a):
מֹשֶׁה קְרָאוֹ עָרֵל
"Moshe called it 'uncircumcised'"
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁבֶּאֱמֶת לֵב יִשְׂרָאֵל רַק לַאֲבִיהֶן שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם, וְהַיֵּצֶר הָרָע רַק כְּעָרֵל שֶׁעוֹמֵד וּמְפַתֶּה וְאֵינוֹ חֵלֶק יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּלָל.

meaning that in truth the heart of Israel belongs solely to their Father in Heaven, while the evil inclination is merely like an uncircumcised outsider standing and enticing, and is not part of Israel at all.
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמְרוּ
And this is what they said
(Shabbos 105b):
אֵל זָר שֶׁבְּגוּפוֹ — זֶה יֵצֶר הָרָע
"'The strange god within his body'—this is the evil inclination"
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁהוּא כֹּה זָר, וְזֶהוּ אֵל זָר.
meaning that it is utterly foreign, and thus it is a "strange god."
וְעִנְיַן מְחִיַּית עֲמָלֵק לְהוֹרִיק הָרַע מִלֵּב כְּסִיל.
And the essence of blotting out Amalek is to empty the evil from the fool's heart.
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּתִיקּוּנֵי זֹהַר: אַרְבַּע סְרֵי יוֹמֵי דְּפִסְחָא, שִׁבְעָה דְּגָלוּתָא קַדְמָאָה, שִׁבְעָה דְּגָלוּתָא בַּתְרָאָה
And this is what they said in Tikkunei Zohar: "The fourteen days of Pesach, seven of the first exile and seven of the final exile"
הַיְינוּ בְּכָל שָׁנָה יֵשׁ שִׁבְעָה יְמֵי פֶּסַח הַשְׁבָּתַת שְׂאוֹר וְחָמֵץ, סָמֶ"ךְ מֵ"ם וְנָחָשׁ,
meaning that every year there are seven days of Pesach for eliminating leaven and chametz, Satan and the Serpent,
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמְרוּ
and this is what they said
(פְּסָחִים ב'.):
(Pesachim 2a):
אוֹר לְי"ד בּוֹדְקִין אֶת הֶחָמֵץ — שְׂאוֹר שֶׁבָּעִיסָּה.
"On the evening of the fourteenth we search for chametz"—the leaven in the dough.
וְאִם לֹא הָיָה הַקִּלְקוּל בִּשְׁעַת מַתַּן תּוֹרָה, דִּכְתִיב
And had there not been the corruption [of the Golden Calf] at the time of the Giving of the Torah, of which it is written
(תְּהִלִּים פ"ב, ו'):
(Tehillim 82:6):
אֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִים אַתֶּם,
"I said, you are angelic beings,"
דְּלָא הֲווֹ מַיְיתֵי
so that they would not have died
(עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה ה'.),
(Avodah Zarah 5a),
וּמִן הַסְּתָם הָיָה נִתְקָן כָּל הַפְּגַם הַנָּחָשׁ שֶׁהִכְנִיס תַּאֲוָה וְהַרְגָּשַׁת הֲנָאַת הַגּוּף,
presumably the entire blemish of the Serpent—which injected lust and the sensation of bodily gratification—would have been rectified,
וְכֵיוָן שֶׁהָיָה חֵירוּת מִמַּלְאַךְ הַמָּוֶת
and since there was freedom from the Angel of Death
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בִּשְׁמוֹת רַבָּה ל"ב, א' וְנִתְבָּאֵר פָּרָשַׁת כִּי תִשָּׂא),
(as they said in Shemos Rabbah 32:1 and as explained in Parshas Ki Sisa),
הָיָה חֵירוּת גַּם מִיֵּצֶר הָרָע,
there would also have been freedom from the evil inclination,
דְּהוּא יֵצֶר הָרָע, הוּא שָׂטָן, הוּא מַלְאַךְ הַמָּוֶת
for "he is the evil inclination, he is Satan, he is the Angel of Death"
(בָּבָא בַּתְרָא ט"ז.),
(Bava Basra 16a),
וְהָיָה אָז מְחִיַּית עֲמָלֵק יִצְרָא בִּישָׁא מִכֹּל וָכֹל בָּרִאשׁוֹן בְּי"ד.
and then Amalek—the evil inclination—would have been completely blotted out in that first redemption on the fourteenth.
אַךְ אַחַר הַקִּלְקוּל שֶׁחָזַר יֵצֶר הָרָע לִמְקוֹמוֹ,
However, after the corruption when the evil inclination returned to its place,
בְּכָל שָׁנָה הַזְּמַן בְּפֶסַח לְבַעֵר שְׂאוֹר וְחָמֵץ,
every year Pesach is the time to burn out leaven and chametz,
עַד שִׁבְעָה דְּגָלוּתָא בַּתְרָאָה שֶׁעָתִיד הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אָז לִשְׁחוֹט לְיֵצֶר הָרָע
until the seven days of the final exile, when the Holy One, blessed is He, will slaughter the evil inclination
(סוּכָּה שָׁם).
(Sukkah, ibid.).
וּבְהַקְדָּמַת תִּיקּוּנֵי זֹהַר
And in the Introduction to Tikkunei Zohar
רָמַז אוֹר לְי"ד עַל י"ד יוֹמָא דְּפוּרִים,
it alluded "the evening of the fourteenth" to the fourteenth day of Purim,
שֶׁהוּא גַּם כֵּן זְמַן מְחִיַּית עֲמָלֵק וְהֲכָנָה שֶׁיִּזְכּוּ לִהְיוֹת בְּנִיסָן נִגְאָלִין
which is also a time of blotting out Amalek and a preparation to merit being redeemed in Nisan
(רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה י"א.).
(Rosh Hashanah 11a).
וּבְרַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא
And in Ra'aya Mehemna
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג' רל"ב:)
(Zohar, Vol. 3, 232b)
דְּעֵרֶב רַב גָּרוּעַ מִשִּׁיעְבּוּד מַלְכִיּוֹת,
it states that the Mixed Multitude is worse than subjugation to the kingdoms
וְהַיְינוּ דְּשִׁיעְבּוּד מַלְכִיּוֹת גּוֹרֵם שֶׁיִּכְנוֹס הַשְּׂאוֹר שֶׁבָּעִיסָּה בְּלֵב יִשְׂרָאֵל,
meaning that subjugation to the kingdoms causes the leaven in the dough to enter the heart of Israel,
וְעַל יְדֵי הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע שֶׁהוּא הַשָּׂטָן יֵשׁ קִטְרוּג עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל, וּמִזֶּה מִמֵּילָא בָּא הַשִּׁיעְבּוּד מַלְכִיּוֹת, וְהָא בְּהָא תַּלְיָא וְהַכֹּל אֶחָד.
and through the evil inclination—which is Satan—there is prosecution against Israel, from which automatically comes subjugation to the kingdoms; thus one depends on the other and all are one.
וְעַל יְדֵי הָעֵרֶב רַב שֶׁעָשׂוּ אֶת הָעֵגֶל
And through the Mixed Multitude who made the Golden Calf
(שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה מ"ב, ו')
(Shemos Rabbah 42:6)
וְאָמְרוּ: אֵלֶּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל,
and declared, "These are your gods, O Israel,"
חָזַר יֵצֶר הָרָע לִמְקוֹמוֹ בְּלֵב כְּסִיל לִשְׂמֹאלוֹ,
the evil inclination returned to its place in "the fool's heart at his left,"
וְזֶה קְלִיפַּת סָמֶ"ךְ מֵ"ם וְנָחָשׁ, וּמְעוֹרָבִין בְּלֵב יִשְׂרָאֵל עֵרֶב רַב;
which is the husk of Satan and the Serpent, intermingled within the heart of Israel as the Mixed Multitude;
וּכְשֶׁיִּזְכּוּ לִמְחִיַּית עֲמָלֵק מִכֹּל וָכֹל, יִתְבַּטֵּל הַסָּמֶ"ךְ מֵ"ם וְהַיֵּצֶר הָרָע וּמִיָּד נִגְאָלִין.
and when they merit the total eradication of Amalek, Satan and the evil inclination will be nullified and they will be immediately redeemed.

The leaven in the dough and the subjugation to the kingdoms.…" Rashi: the leaven in the dough — the evil inclination in our heart, which sours us.

paragraphs.text: Zohar III 232b, 237b (Pinchas, Ra'aya Mehemna) — "Because the Erev Rav are the leaven in the dough, they hold Israel back in exile more than the idolatrous nations, as the Sages explained: 'Who holds back? The leaven in the dough' — for they cling to Israel like leaven in dough; the nations are only 'like chaff the wind drives away.'" 237b applies it to the time "when the Erev Rav are heads over Israel."

paragraphs.text: Parallel: R. Yaakov Yosef of Polnoye, Tzafnas Paneach, Yisro — “‘Remember what Amalek did to you’—to you, the select ones called Israel, the servants of Hashem—what was done to you by the type of Amalek mixed in among Israel, the leaven in the dough that holds back from the service of Hashem those who have set out on the path of repentance. Therefore ‘you shall blot out the memory of Amalek,’ for the essential enemy has no remedy except to be eradicated from the world. And this is the matter of removing chametz and leaven, which must be eradicated from the world, for they are the leaven in the dough that holds back.” Connection: The Toldos identifies, as Rav Tzadok does, the Amalek mixed among Israel with “the leaven in the dough” of Berachos 17a, and links blotting out Amalek with the removal of chametz.

paragraphs.text: Sukkah 52a — "R. Avira expounded: The evil inclination has seven names. The Holy One, blessed is He, called it 'evil'… Moshe called it 'uncircumcised' (arel), as it says, 'Circumcise the foreskin of your heart' (Devarim 10:16); David called it 'impure'…" Rashi does not comment on these words.

paragraphs.text: Parallel: Sod Yesharim, First Night of Pesach 44 — “The thought of Israel is always bound to the root of the Supernal Will, by the intention for the sake of Heaven found in all their deeds, even in deeds done without awareness. But this point of intention for Heaven’s sake is greatly hidden because of the leaven in the dough, which conceals this bond and hides the point. Therefore it says, ‘Sanctify to Me every firstborn’: a person should rouse his deeds and strip the leaven in the dough from them, and then this point will be revealed in them, and he will see plainly how the root of his thought is bound to the Supernal Will without any interruption.” Connection: The same view that Israel’s heart belongs wholly to God while the leaven is an outer covering; Sod Yesharim adds that removing it reveals the bond hidden even in unaware deeds.

paragraphs.text: Parallel: Machshavos Charutz 16 — “It is known that every war of the outer enemy is drawn from the war of the inner enemy; as much as one subdues the inclination, so much are the enemies subdued. At the Giving of the Torah, when they became free of the evil inclination, they became free of subjugation to the kingdoms, for the one depends on the other: the leaven in the dough and subjugation to the kingdoms, this drawn from that and that from this. And the first drawing of the nations’ counsel into the heart of a Jew is not to remove the fear of Hashem entirely, for he would not listen at once; the beginning is to cool the warmth in the Jewish heart for the service of Hashem.” Connection: The same mutual dependence of the leaven and the kingdoms, joined to the freedom at Sinai, adding Amalek’s first step: cooling, not outright denial.
